<a id="music_transpose"></a>
### [`music_transpose`](../../../../src/music/music_voice_state.asm#L7) `$E100`

*variable*

Music voice state ($E100-$E12D, 46 bytes). music_reset_state copies music_voice_init over it before each song. The arrays of 3 bytes are indexed by the voice number 0-2 (SID voice 1-3).
semitones added to every note; reset to 0 for each song

- **Read by:** [`music_voice_start_note`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_start_note) [`$E591`](../../../../src/music/music_player_e38c.asm#L334)
- **Written by:** [`music_reset_state`](music_player_e38c.md#music_reset_state) [`$E3CE`](../../../../src/music/music_player_e38c.asm#L43), [`music_song_end_action`](music_player_e38c.md#music_song_end_action) [`$E469`](../../../../src/music/music_player_e38c.asm#L178)
- **Referred to by:** [`music_reset_state`](music_player_e38c.md#music_reset_state) [`$E3B5`](../../../../src/music/music_player_e38c.asm#L30)

### [`music_voice_tie`](../../../../src/music/music_voice_state.asm#L8) `$E101-$E103`

<a id="music_voice_ticks"></a>
### [`music_voice_ticks`](../../../../src/music/music_voice_state.asm#L9) `$E104-$E106`

*variable*

Tick counter per voice. It counts down from music_voice_gate_ticks; at 0 the gate goes off, and when it reaches music_voice_end_tick (a negative value) the next note starts.

<a id="music_voice_articulation"></a>
### [`music_voice_articulation`](../../../../src/music/music_voice_state.asm#L16) `$E119-$E11B`

*variable*

Articulation per voice: 0 = normal (gate off for the last 1/8 of the note), 1 = staccato (gate off for the second half), 2 = legato (gate off for the last tick only). Commands $A4-$A6.

- **Read by:** [`music_voice_commands`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_commands) [`$E603`](../../../../src/music/music_player_e38c.asm#L407)
- **Written by:** [`music_voice_commands`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_commands) [`$E657`](../../../../src/music/music_player_e38c.asm#L453)

<a id="music_envelopes"></a>
### [`music_envelopes`](../../../../src/music/music_voice_state.asm#L17) `$E11C-$E12D`

*variable*

Envelopes of the current instrument, 6 bytes per voice (voice 0 at +0, 1 at +6, 2 at +12): AD and SR for articulation 0, AD and SR for articulation 1, AD and SR for articulation 2. Command $Bn copies instrument n here; commands $A4-$A6 load the pair of the chosen articulation.

- **Read by:** [`music_voice_commands`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_commands) [`$E666`](../../../../src/music/music_player_e38c.asm#L462) (+4), [`music_voice_commands`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_commands) [`$E66A`](../../../../src/music/music_player_e38c.asm#L464) (+5), [`music_voice_commands`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_commands) [`$E677`](../../../../src/music/music_player_e38c.asm#L472) (+2), [`music_voice_commands`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_commands) [`$E67B`](../../../../src/music/music_player_e38c.asm#L474) (+3), [`music_voice_commands`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_commands) [`$E681`](../../../../src/music/music_player_e38c.asm#L477), [`music_voice_commands`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_commands) [`$E685`](../../../../src/music/music_player_e38c.asm#L479) (+1)
